args.query: Temporal TypeScript SDK workflow with signals and queries

results.title: Temporal polyfill PlainDate and Duration
results.summary: Work with calendar dates using @js-temporal/polyfill Temporal.PlainDate and Duration, covering add, until and timezone-free math offline.

results.title: transitions order workflow with conditions and callbacks
results.summary: An order workflow state machine built with transitions, covering states, triggers, guarded conditions, before/after callbacks via EventData and MachineError on invalid moves, tested offline.

results.title: Generate TypeScript types from JSON Schema with json-schema-to-typescript
results.summary: Compile JSON Schemas into TypeScript interfaces with json-schema-to-typescript, covering required and optional fields, enums, $ref definitions, descriptions as JSDoc and strict additionalProperties.

results.title: openapi-typescript generate types
results.summary: Generate TypeScript types from an inline OpenAPI 3.1 document with the openapi-typescript programmatic API using openapiTS and astToString, asserting generated interface members and path keys offline.

results.title: Anthropic TypeScript SDK tool use loop, tested with a mocked fetch
results.summary: Run a Claude tool_use loop with the official Anthropic SDK and Zod-validated tool inputs, tested offline with an injected fetch.

results.title: Django post_save signal enqueuing a Celery task, tested with eager mode and on_commit
results.summary: A post_save signal queues a Celery task only after the row commits via transaction.on_commit, then tests run offline on in-memory SQLite with Celery eager mode and pytest-django's on_commit capture.

results.title: AWS SDK v3 DynamoDB document client and SQS events, tested with Vitest matchers
results.summary: A single-table DynamoDB order service on @aws-sdk/lib-dynamodb with conditional puts, begins_with queries and optimistic locking, publishing SQS events, tested offline with aws-sdk-client-mock and aws-sdk-client-mock-vitest matchers.

results.title: Preact components with Signals state, tested with Testing Library on jsdom
results.summary: A Preact 11 cart using @preact/signals signal and computed state plus a hooks-based async form, tested in Vitest on jsdom with @testing-library/preact and user-event, including re-render on signal change without new props.

results.title: Anthropic SDK message streaming with text deltas, tested with a mocked SSE fetch
results.summary: Stream Claude responses with the Anthropic TypeScript SDK (messages.stream, text events, finalMessage), tested offline with a fake fetch returning Anthropic SSE events.

results.title: AWS SDK v3 S3 storage helpers tested with aws-sdk-client-mock
results.summary: S3 helpers on @aws-sdk/client-s3 for JSON put/get with NoSuchKey handling, paginated listing, batched DeleteObjects and locally signed presigned URLs, tested offline with aws-sdk-client-mock and sdkStreamMixin bodies.
